note: Earth values are monthly climatology. The reference site uses its single long-term value, because monthly reference data is not loaded.
caveat: The reference temperature is a one-month average, not an annual mean, so this ranking mostly shows when the Earth temperature is closest to that single value. Treat it as an indication, not as a recommendation of the best season.
disclaimer: Environmental Similarity Index for specific measurable parameters. It is not a validated habitat suitability score.
